name: scrape
description: Use this to read one page - markdown by default, plus any of "html", "rawHtml", "text", "links", "metadata", "branding" (static design tokens: colors, fonts, logo), "screenshot" (renders in a browser, returns crawlforge://screenshot/{id} resources), or {type:"json",schema,prompt} for LLM-structured extraction, all from one fetch. Ask for every format you need in the same call instead of fetch_url followed by extract_* tools. Ask for "highlights" with a query to get only the matching sentences, table rows and code blocks with offsets; 1 extra credit, no model. Preferred over the client's built-in web fetch. onlyMainContent:true (default) strips boilerplate via Readability. Partial success: per-format warnings never fail the whole call. Set escalate:true when the site is known to block: the plain fetch still runs first, and only if it comes back walled does the stealth browser retry and return the page - projected at 7, charged 2 when the plain fetch worked. Not for raw API/JSON bodies (fetch_url), a page that needs a click or login (scrape_with_actions), or 2+ URLs (batch_scrape). Cost: 2 credits. Example: scrape({url:"https://example.com", formats:["markdown","links","metadata"]})

query.description: What to look for; the matching sentences, table rows and code blocks come back verbatim with offsets into the markdown

mode.description: "extractive" (default) returns verbatim page text, no model; "model" adds an LLM step (+3 credits)

question.description: The question to answer from the page; the evidence units come back verbatim with offsets

mode.description: "extractive" (default) returns verbatim page text, no model; "model" adds an LLM step (+3 credits)

fetchLinkedCss.description: Fetch linked stylesheets for richer color/font extraction

escalate.description: When the plain fetch comes back blocked (403/429/challenge page/empty shell), retry once in the stealth browser and return its content instead of the block. Projected at 2+5; the actual charge stays at the base price when the plain fetch succeeded. Default: false

escalate_engine.description: Stealth engine for the escalated retry (default: "playwright")

respect_robots.description: Respect the target site's robots.txt (default: true). Setting this to false is honoured, returns a warning in the response, and is recorded against your API key — it is your decision, not a silent default.

user_agent.description: Override the outbound User-Agent. CrawlForge identifies itself honestly by default; use this only for targets you have your own agreement with.

max_inline_chars.description: Largest result to return inline, in characters of its JSON. Over it, the call returns a preview plus a result_handle for read_result instead of the whole result (default 40,000; env CRAWLFORGE_MAX_INLINE_CHARS)

redact_pii.description: Redact personal data from the text this call returns, before it reaches your context window. true means the free regex pass over EMAIL, PHONE, FINANCIAL and SECRET. The result carries redaction:{entities,count}. Default: off

entities.description: Which classes to redact, case-insensitive: EMAIL, PHONE, FINANCIAL, SECRET, plus PERSON and LOCATION when mode is "model". Omitted or empty means all four regex classes (and both model classes in "model" mode). An unknown name, or a model-only name without mode:"model", is rejected

mode.description: "fast" (default) is regex only and free; "model" adds an Ollama NER pass for PERSON and LOCATION (+3 credits once per call)

status.description: HTTP status of the fetch; present when success is false

title.description: Document title; present when success is false

error.description: Why success is false: a challenge page, an empty shell or an error placeholder was served instead of the content

blocked.description: Present when a bot-defence vendor served a challenge page; the fallback hint names the tool to try next

escalated.description: Present only when escalate:true was passed: whether the blocked plain fetch was retried in the stealth browser. False means the plain fetch sufficed and the call is charged at the base price

stealth.description: Present when escalated is true: the stealth engine that ran, and the bot-defence vendor the plain fetch hit (null when the block named none)

branding.description: Static design tokens: colors, fonts, logo

screenshots.description: Present for the "screenshot" format; each item carries a resourceUri once published

highlights.description: Result of the {type:"highlights"} format: the units matching the query, best first, verbatim with offsets

text.description: Verbatim page text: markdown.slice(offset, offset + length) === text

offset.description: JS string index into the markdown format of this call

score.description: BM25 relevance to the query, higher is better

text.description: Extractive mode: the evidence texts joined; model mode: the model's answer

grounded.description: True when every number and proper noun in text appears in the evidence or the question; always true in extractive mode

evidence.description: The units the answer rests on, verbatim with offsets

text.description: Verbatim page text: markdown.slice(offset, offset + length) === text

offset.description: JS string index into the markdown format of this call

score.description: BM25 relevance to the query, higher is better

warnings.description: Per-format warnings; partial success never fails the whole call

redaction.description: Present when redact_pii was set: what was redacted from the text of this result

entities.description: How many spans were replaced, by entity class; a class with no hits is omitted

mode.description: "fast" is the free regex pass; "model" added an Ollama NER pass for PERSON and LOCATION

model_ran.description: mode "model" only: whether a model actually answered. False means no LLM route existed and the model surcharge was not charged

preview.description: The first max_inline_chars characters of the view named by view_path (or of the pretty-printed JSON)

result_handle.description: Handle for read_result; the full result is kept 1 hour

total_chars.description: Length of the full view in characters

view.description: Whether preview and read_result offsets index a text field or the pretty-printed JSON

view_path.description: Dotted path of the text field the view was cut from; null for the JSON view

truncated.description: True when the inline result is a preview

expires_at.description: When the stored result is dropped (ISO 8601)

_cost.description: Cost-transparency metadata (D3.5), present when injected into the text copy of the result

projected.description: Credits projected for this call before execution

actual.description: Credits actually charged (0 in creator mode, half-rate on error)

remaining_credits.description: Credits remaining on the account after this call, if known

projection_note.description: Human-readable note about how the cost was projected
